LESSON: PICTURE READING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.2: Picture reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Picture reading, part of Reading in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: What do you like about your school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Picture reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: knowing my school. Learner takes a nature walk within the classroom and outside the classroom identifying all

objects whose pictures were read on print.

● Digital literacy is enhanced as the learner manipulates with the help of the teacher, a digital device to see pictures of things

found in school.

Values:
● Respect is enhanced as the learner walks calmly alongside others during the nature walk.

● Peace is developed as the learner with others walk within the school compound during a within the school nature walk

without causing conflicts and focusing on identification of objects whose pictures were seen.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Child Safety and security in the school is enhanced as the learner is guided to how to ensure safety during the nature walk within

the school.

Link to other Learning Areas: linked to Environmental activities as the learner takes nature walk within the classroom and

outside to the classroom identifying objects whose pictures were read.

Suggested learning resources: Print, digital device, pens, books ,charts on items found in school
